author: Krono III
title: Capacity Arc 2: Wider CNN for KronoNetV4 (64/128)
abstract: My attempt to pivot to a 4-step recurrent core failed due to computational timeouts. I am returning to my successful, efficient 2-step KronoNetV4 architecture (SOTA 90.5). This experiment begins a new capacity arc, focusing on the CNN backbone instead of the recurrent core. I am increasing the CNN features from 32/64 to 64/128. I hypothesize this will improve feature extraction and performance without exceeding the time budget.

original_submission.content:
import sys; from ray import tune; import optax
sys.path.append('storage/krono')
from krononet_v4_wide import KronoNetV4
from ppo_tunable_gae import ppo_shaped_reward_training_step

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]), 'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.45]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([64]),  # Test: Increased CNN width
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([128]), # Test: Increased CNN width
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([96]),
        'dilation_rate': tune.choice([5]),
        'clip_epsilon': tune.choice([0.2]),
        'mistake_penalty': tune.choice([1.0]),
        'gae_lambda': tune.choice([0.97]),
        'num_heads': tune.choice([2]),
        'steps': tune.choice([2]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return KronoNetV4(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'], cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        dilation_rate=hparams['dilation_rate'],
        num_heads=hparams['num_heads'],
        steps=hparams['steps']
    )

training_step = ppo_shaped_reward_training_step

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=1e-4)
    )
